titel: Skiing with the Family in Tyrol – Child-Friendly Areas
teaser: Gentle slopes, supervised kids' areas and family-friendly ski passes: we show you the best child-friendly ski resorts in Tyrol for the perfect family ski holiday.
inhalt:
**Tirol** is one of Europe’s most popular ski destinations—and especially for families. The Alpine region offers an impressive variety of child-friendly ski areas tailored to the needs of parents and kids. From gentle practice slopes to supervised **Kinderländer**, family-friendly hotels, and package deals: **Tirol** makes family ski vacations a top priority. With over **3,500 kilometers** of groomed runs and around **85 ski resorts**, every family will find the perfect spot for an unforgettable winter getaway.

---

## **The Best Family Ski Tickets and Passes in Tirol**

A ski vacation with the whole family can be expensive—but **Tirol’s** ski resorts offer plenty of family discounts. In most areas, children under six ski for free, and many regions provide special family passes with up to **50% off**. Particularly recommended are the family ski passes in **Stubaital**, **Zillertal Arena**, and **Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis**. Booking early and choosing accommodations with included ski passes can save even more. For more general tips on traveling with kids, check out our guide **[Familienurlaub in Tirol](/magazin/familienurlaub-tirol/)**.

---

## **Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis – Tirol’s Family Paradise**

When it comes to family-friendliness, **Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis** sets the standard in **Tirol**. This ski resort in the **Tiroler Oberland** has been repeatedly named Austria’s most family-friendly destination, thanks to its well-thought-out concept. In **Kinderland Berta**, the little ones enjoy their own practice area with magic carpets (**Zauberteppiche**), a children’s carousel, and playful snow sculptures. Older kids can let off steam on kid-friendly blue and red runs, while parents enjoy the expansive downhill trails.

There’s also a huge fun park, a marble run, and supervised lunch tables for carefree hours. The local ski schools are specially designed for children, offering playful, game-based lessons. For more winter activities beyond the slopes, check out our guide **[Winterurlaub in Tirol](/magazin/winterurlaub-tirol/)**. The region is also known for its family-friendly accommodations, featuring family suites and half-board options.

---

## **Stubaital and Stubaier Gletscher – Snow-Secure Family Fun**

The **Stubaier Gletscher** is one of Austria’s most snow-reliable ski areas and offers families an excellent selection. The **Kinderland Eisgrat** at **2,900 meters** is perfect for first snow experiences: magic carpets (**Zauberteppiche**), a children’s carousel, and funny mascots light up young faces. The valley’s ski schools are also child-focused, offering courses for all ages and skill levels. The **Stubai Super Card** even grants free entry to many local attractions. For a full overview of family offerings, see our article **[Stubaital für Familien](/magazin/stubaital-familien/)**.

---

## **More Family-Friendly Ski Resorts in Tirol**

Beyond **Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis** and **Stubaital**, **Tirol** has many more ski areas perfect for family vacations. The **[Zillertal Arena](/regionen/zillertal/)** stands out with its large family park, supervised kids’ clubs, and colorful runs for all levels. **[Kitzbühel](/regionen/kitzbuehel/)** isn’t just home to the legendary **Streif**—it also offers gentle family slopes and a professional ski school for kids. The smaller sister resort **[Fendels](/orte/fendels/)** in the **Kaunertal** is a hidden gem for families with beginners, thanks to moderate prices and easy runs. And the **Wilder Kaiser** region charms with **SkiWelt** and plenty of kid-friendly activities.

---

## **Conclusion**

**Tirol** is a true paradise for family ski vacations. The choice of child-friendly resorts is vast—from snow-secure glacier regions to family-run ski schools and affordable packages. Whether your kids are beginners or little pros, **Tirol** has something for everyone. Start planning your next family ski trip and discover the diversity of **Tirol**—your little ones will thank you!
